title: Large-Library Query, Pagination & Lazy Retrieval
objective: Define indexed search/filter/sort/pagination and bounded lazy loading for reusable-resource catalogs, proving representative 1k/10k/50k synthetic tiers without requiring whole-library memory residency.

owner_sequence_authorization.source: Explicit owner instruction in this execution on 2026-09-11

selection_boundaries: ARI-14 is completed_verified and owns semantic tags, collections and family grouping only.
ARI-15 owns indexed search/filter/sort/pagination and bounded lazy retrieval only.
Large-library retrieval preserves ARI resource identity, provenance and ARI-11 rights/use-capability filtering; catalog scale grants no new content or provider authority.
ARI-16 MAI bridge work and all later ARI implementation remain inactive until separately governed-started.
